text:
maria: Quick sync 1: proposal updated: compact envelopes v2 but with per-fragment vector stamps instead of monotonic seq to better handle multi-producer interleaving. main goals: shrink payloads, keep exact cost attribution, avoid heavy state in ingest.
ajay: Vector stamps sound heavier than seqs. how do we reconcile size vs correctness?
maria: vector stamp is 2 bytes for common case (shard id + small counter) and expands only when multiple writers overlap. typical path: single-writer cheap, multi-writer slows but still better than full-span duplicate. ingest applies fragments by comparing stamps and using a tombstone map for replaced ranges.
kai: Ingest state concerns: tombstone map still increases memory. what's eviction / snapshot policy?
maria: Evict tombstones after 20s; keep a lightweight bloom to detect replays for 60s. if bloom says possible duplicate but tombstone missing, we conservatively accept and mark "ambiguous" for downstream billing reconciliation.
sophia: Rollout plan suggestion: dual-write for 72h on staging, then 24h canary, then 5% global for 48h. During dual-write we record three metrics: bytes_saved_ratio, reassembly_success_rate, billing_delta_ratio.
ajay: For billing_delta_ratio we need deterministic token proxies. propose a nightly SnQL that joins dual_write pairs and computes token_estimate_diff per request_id. example snippet: 
```
SELECT request_id, avg(token_proxy_delta) as avg_diff FROM telemetry_envelopes
WHERE dual_written=true AND ts >= now()-24h GROUP BY request_id HAVING count()=2
```
if avg_diff > 0.001 tokens per request we alert.
kai: How do we treat sampling? if edge sampling drops fragments, vector stamps might reference missing fragments. We need a canonical "sampled_from" header.
maria: add header X-RDW-Sampled-From: <collector-id> and include a minimal "missing_ranges" list encoded as compressed varints. Reassembly tolerates up to 3 missing ranges and marks partial_count otherwise.
sophia: dashboard items: per-shard reassembly_success_rate, per-shard bytes_saved_95thpct, ambiguous_replays_count, partials_rate. I can wire alerts: >0.5% partials -> paging.
ajay: Security: fragments must be integrity-protected and authenticated. HMAC header is fine but we also need a cheap version marker for old agents. version negotiation header: X-RDW-Env: v=2;fw=vector.
kai: Edge-case: model-router will fan-out fragments across instances. vector stamping needs writer-id namespace (instance_id) to avoid collisions. also ensure 128-bit nonce in header for anti-collision.
maria: agreed: vector stamp = (instance_id_short, local_counter). nonce=128 bits. ingest reconstructs per (request_id, model_instance).
ajay: Operational guard: if reassembly_success_rate drops >1% in 15m window, auto-enable opaque-fallback-mode on the shard (ingest discards fragments and only accepts full envelopes).
sophia: For the nightly reconciliation job: we should compute billing reconciliation at customer granularity too (billing_key) and ensure no regressions >0.1% revenue delta per day. add a canary customer check.
maria: dev checklist i've added to RFC: header formats, vector-stamp RFC appendix, bloom/tombstone sizes with simulation numbers, HMAC spec, fallback modes, rollout timeline. will PR tonight.
kai: i'll run a sim with 10M rps equivalent trace to pick LRU sizes and bloom fp targets. aim for <5% extra mem per shard.
ajay: +1 on adding reconciliation job and auto-fallback circuit. also add a metric for "ambiguous_attribution_count" so finance can triage.
sophia: +1. i'll make a dashboard skeleton and add on-call playbook steps: when to flip dual-write, when to roll back, and how to interpret ambiguous_attribution.
obs-bot: infra-bot: staging rollout scheduled: compact-env-v2 staged at 2026-03-23T15:40Z.
maria: thanks team 1: action owners pinned in RFC. if no objections by EOD tomorrow i'll start the staging dual-write.
ajay: sounds good.
kai: will post sim numbers before EOD.
sophia: will post dashboard link when ready.
Notes: keep message short in thread, record numeric metrics not blobs, plan for conservative auto-fallback to protect billing accuracy.
